main_validator.rule: per sample and patch: over >= MIN_PATCH_VERTICES, minGap >= band low, p50 <= band high, band/over >= MIN_BAND_COVERAGE (soles too, band 0..+1 cm)

cushion.source: root chair surface report (actual UE cushion triangles)

measurement: fit_seat_pelvis_pitch finish_clip actual-chair read-back of each committed GLB (Trial.seat / Trial.soles patch_metrics: over = facing-down skin over the surface, band = in-band count, lowest = minGap, median = p50); skin every vertex of the owner patch sets in the source npz
input_mapping_note: p10/p90/max are not used by main validate(); they are filled with the median. Non-DeskTyping frames are each judged as a 301-sample constant block because main validate() requires exactly 301 samples.
